newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 97 deficit heads for 75-76 trln lire - ANSA.
newsitem.headline: Italy 97 deficit heads for 75-76 trln lire - ANSA.

text.p: Italy's 1997 public deficit is on course to hit 75 trillion to 76 trillion lire against a target of 61.4 trillion, the Italian news agency ANSA quoted a senior Treasury Ministry official as saying on Friday.

ANSA quoted Treasury undersecretary Giorgio Macciotta as saying quarterly state accounts containing the forecast would be published on Friday or Saturday. It said the figures pointed to the need for a 97 mini-budget of 15 to 16 trillion lire.
The cabinet was meeting on Friday and political sources said ministers were expected to discuss the quarterly accounts, though the issue was not on the formal agenda.

The accounts will determine the size of the mini-budget, which Prime Minister Romano Prodi has said the centre-left government will draw up to try to ensure Italy meets the key deficit target required to join economic and monetary union.
Cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli said on Thursday that the mini-budget would be presented by March 30.
Public broadcaster RAI, quoting an unnamed financial source, said on Thursday that the package would comprise deficit-cutting measures of more than 15 trillion lire.
